responsibilities_block: Climb towers for scheduled inspections of blades, bolts, drive-train components, and electrical systems.
Troubleshoot turbine faults, replace damaged components, and restore operation.
Perform maintenance such as torque verification and lubricant changes according to procedures.
Read and analyze SCADA operating data to identify abnormal turbines.
Follow work-at-height safety procedures and inspect tools and protective equipment.
Complete maintenance work orders, spare-parts records, and safety reports.
page.work_context_block: The workday revolves around climbing towers, diagnosing problems, and correcting defects. At the morning briefing, technicians receive assignments and use the turbine alert list to decide which units to visit. Before climbing, they verify dual safety connections. In the nacelle, they listen to bearings, check oil levels, and recheck critical bolts with a torque wrench. Blade cracks are photographed and reported; serious faults are scheduled for disassembly and replacement that day. Back at the site lodging that evening, they finish the work orders.
